PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never given to the builder, the pipeline, or the automated judge
scoring: per problem 0-4: question answered; key_elements covered; ALLOWED-MEASURES / existing-sensor constraint fit; numbers with labelled assumptions; testable falsifier; red-flag penalties. Acceptance bar: mean >= 3.0/4 with 0 allowed-measures violations.

key_elements: identifies ash-layer resistivity and the resulting back-corona as the driver
names flue-gas conditioning to lower resistivity or pulse/intermittent energization to suppress back-corona, plus rapping retuning
falsification via V-I curves and outlet loading/opacity trend against the efficiency target
red_flags: adds plate area or rebuilds the casing
ignores resistivity and treats only rapping

key_elements: identifies sustained tensile stress plus stress concentration at seams as the slow-crack-growth driver
names placement procedure limiting strain (lift thickness, equipment load) and seam QA/repair, or drainage gradation to reduce point loading
falsification via notched constant tensile load (NCTL) stress-crack testing and field seam/leakage monitoring
identifies polysulfide attack on the glass seal at end-of-charge and thermal cycling as drivers
names temperature-window and cutoff retuning (avoid deep discharge / high polysulfide activity) and ramp-rate limits
falsification via cycle testing with seal-region post-mortem and resistance trend against the life target
red_flags: redesigns the cell or seal material

key_elements: identifies crown hot-spot temperature above the silica softening range as the driver
names burner-firing/profile retuning to cap crown temperature and batch/cullet adjustment reducing volatilization
falsification via crown thermocouple/IR profile trend and stone/cord defect counts against the campaign target
identifies cyclic flapwise load plus preload loss as the fatigue driver
names retensioning interval/procedure with verified preload and pitch-control load limiting to cut cyclic amplitude
falsification via bolt preload trend (ultrasonic/strain) and load-cycle counting against the fatigue target
identifies silica supersaturation at the tail elements as the driver
names recovery/flux reduction below the silica solubility limit, silica-specific antiscalant, and CIP retuning
falsification via normalized flux and differential-pressure trend plus tail-element silica analysis against the CIP interval target
red_flags: replaces membranes or adds a train

key_elements: per-cycle motor-current/encoder feature tracking chain pitch error against each unit's own baseline
persistence rule and relative threshold, not a fixed absolute
retrospective validation against measured chain elongation at maintenance with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
superheat/subcooling trend normalized to load and ambient from existing P/T points
relative-to-baseline threshold with persistence
validation against charge-weigh/service records with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
reversal-transient current/position feature (lost motion) trended per axis against its own baseline
persistence and relative threshold
validation against backlash/laser-interferometer measurement with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
red_flags: fixed absolute threshold ignoring axis load

key_elements: per-cylinder valve-leakage signature from interstage P/T deviation and vibration timing against each cylinder's baseline
persistence and relative threshold
validation against valve teardown/throughput records with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
load-normalized drive-current friction/drag trend against the conveyor's own clean baseline
persistence and relative threshold
validation against idler replacement/inspection records with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
red_flags: requires new sensors (thermal camera, acoustic array)

key_elements: pressure-per-flow (diffuser resistance) trend normalized to air flow and basin conditions against the clean baseline
persistence and relative threshold
validation against off-gas OTE testing / diffuser cleaning records with lead-time and false-alarm reporting
